label: Diagram 4
caption:
Diagram 4 Types of installation | J | ONLINE
GENERAL GUIDANCE | VERSION
description:
Diagram 4, "Types of installation", is a grid of room cross-sections showing gas appliances (each drawn with a flame symbol) and their flue or duct arrangements, with arrows indicating air flow. The top header has two columns, "Open flued" and "Room sealed". The left edge has three row headings: "Natural draught flue", "Fanned flue", and "Fanned or forced draught burner".

The cells are lettered (a) to (f). (a) shows an appliance with a vertical flue rising through the roof, with an arrow pointing upwards. (b) shows an appliance at the left wall with a horizontal double duct to the outside. (c) shows an appliance whose flue ends horizontally at the left wall with a fan symbol and an arrow pointing left. (d) contains two sections: a left one with a horizontal double duct and a right one with a vertical flue with arrows pointing up and down. (e) shows an appliance with a flue extending up and out to the left wall, containing a fan symbol and an arrow pointing left. (f) shows an appliance with a vertical flue that bends at the bottom to exit horizontally to the left, with arrows pointing in and out.

Below the grid is a separate box headed "Flueless" containing diagram (g), an appliance with no flue and small arrows. A "Note – For gas appliances only" at the bottom references CEN TR1749, listing "Type A – Flueless appliances", "Type B – Open flued", "Type C – Room sealed", and states the letters are further qualified by numbers.
